name: Lidingo united sea rings from the laser plates

supersedes.statement: the three coastal-water fragments the model builds from the break geometry are the SAME water at the same level, clipped to the 2,048 m terrain window. They are replaced, not joined: one body, one ring.

isSeaFlag.reason: isSea is not a description of a lake, it is an instruction about the WHOLE WORLD: the engine answers it by laying one plane across the entire heightfield, on the assumption - true only of an unbounded ocean - that everything below that line is water. At Angso that drowned the mainland. This ring is real sea but it STOPS at the 4,096 m acquisition edge, so the assumption does not hold for it. Each ring draws its own sheet regardless, which is what actually makes water visible; the whole-world flag stays off until someone can look at it on a real GPU.

islandsNotSubtracted.reason: the v2 bed carve skips any sample more than surfaceToleranceMetres (0.5 m) above the water level, so an island that stands clear of the sea stands in the render

properties.method: laser-flat plates at one measured level, united so the engine draws ONE sheet over one body; the finer 1 m trace wins where it overlaps the 2 m context trace
